question: Does rajas abandonment from bodily fear yield fruit?
premises: pain-only action abandoned from bodily fear
inference: rajas abandonment from fear does not yield abandonment-fruit
uncertainties: kāyakleśabhayāt may be fear of bodily distress or distress-fear
plain_english: Who abandons action as pain from fear of bodily distress performs rajas abandonment and obtains no fruit of abandonment.
